zh: 标成「完全信任」的电脑不再限每天派几件活，只留一条防失控的上限。
在你这边还没开始执行就失败的活，不占对方当天的名额。
对面的电脑刚启动时问它，不再报「内部错误」，会提示过一分钟再试。
en: A fully trusted computer has no daily limit on requests now; one stop against runaway loops stays.
Work that failed on your side before it started is not counted against the requester.
Asking a computer that has just started no longer says internal error; it says to try again.
